recipes.title: Air fry honey pork belly
recipes.description: The Best Air Fryer Honey Glazed Pork Belly Bites (from thesavorychopstick). Only ~5 min prep.
ingredients: 3-3.5 lbs pork belly - without skin (cut into 1" cubes)
2 tbsp soy sauce (low sodium or regular)
steps: Cut the pork belly into 1" cubes. For best marinade absorption, poke holes with a fork or meat tenderizer on 2 sides of the meat.
Set aside 5 tbsp of the marinade for basting.
Marinate the pork belly in the rest of the marinade.
Air fry at 375°F, adjusting the heat up when the bites are almost done to char the meat.
Cook 12-15 min depending on your air fryer and the size of the pieces - check at the halfway point.
